title: Reliability Initiative Gatekeeper: Automated SLI Reconciliation & Runbook
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Build an 'Initiative Gatekeeper' capability in the Initiative Hub that automatically reconciles SLI definitions, maps initiatives to SLI cohorts, surface divergence from documented SLIs, and produces actionable runbook items and stakeholder nudges when error-budget trajectories deviate from expected profiles.
background: We have many reliability initiatives tracked across teams but inconsistent SLI definitions, drifting measurement tags, and ad-hoc runbooks cause noisy handoffs and missed remediation windows. Current coordination relies on manual spreadsheets and weekly syncs; that model does not scale with Dedicated/Private customer growth and multi-region routing fallbacks.
proposed_solution: Create a Gatekeeper service that ingests SLI configs from the telemetry registry, compares them with initiative-level SLI declarations, and generates a reconciliation report. When divergence or faster-than-expected error budget burn is detected, Gatekeeper will: create a templated incident-style action card in Linear, notify stakeholders via Slack and email, attach the recommended runbook steps (canary rollback, throttle, route fallback), and suggest initiative reprioritization or auto-throttle policies for Dedicated pools.
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (MVP, 4 weeks): SLI reconciliation pipeline + weekly reconciliation report + Linear templated cards to owners. Phase 2 (6 weeks): Real-time burn-rate monitoring, Slack nudges, reversible 'soft throttle' suggestions for Dedicated. Phase 3 (optional): Automated gating for rollouts (block canary promotion if SLI mismatch), analytics dashboards in Console and an 'initiative health' widget.
metrics: % of initiatives with reconciled SLI definitions (target: 95%)
Mean time from SLI divergence detection -> action card created (target: <30m)
% reduction in manual SLI clarification tickets (target: 60% drop)
acceptance_criteria: Gatekeeper can consume at least two telemetry sources (Prometheus metrics and trace-derived SLI) and produce a side-by-side reconciliation for an initiative
Action cards created in Linear include: summary, affected SLI, current burn-rate, recommended runbook steps, and links to dashboards
Weekly reconciliation report is generated and stored in Confluence and linked from the initiative page
Stakeholder notification flow (Slack + email) has opt-out controls per initiative
tasks: Define canonical SLI schema and mapping rules with Applied ML and Observability (owner: PM)
Implement ingestion adapters for Prometheus and trace-derived SLI (owner: ENG)
Build reconciliation engine that compares registry vs initiative declarations (owner: ENG)
Linear action-card template and permission model (owner: PM + ENG)
Notification channels and rate limiting (owner: DEVOPS)
Console widget prototype for initiative health and reconciliation summary (owner: DESIGN + ENG)
E2E tests and QA for false-positive suppression heuristics (owner: SRE)
Create runbook templates for common failure modes (owner: SRE + PM)
Ship Phase 1 and run limited pilot with 3 reliability initiatives (owner: PM)
Collect feedback and iterate before Phase 2 rollout (owner: PM)
Document process in Confluence and schedule training with oncall rotations (owner: PM)
Post-release retrospective and metrics review (owner: PM)
risks: Telemetry mismatches between environments leading to noisy reconciliations
Action-card fatigue if thresholds produce too many cards
Permissions model complexity for cross-org initiatives
Dedicated customers may require different throttle policies than hosted customers
